podcast.title: Spirit of the West Farewell Performance (2016)
podcast.body: Due to the relentless deterioration caused by Alzheimer's, Spirit of the West concluded their career with a farewell performance in 2016. John received immense support from his wife, Jill, throughout his battle with the disease. "Spirit of the West ended with a farewell performance in 2016."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Death from Alzheimer's (2019)
podcast.body: John Mann passed away from Alzheimer's disease on November 20, 2019, after a prolonged struggle with the condition. "who died of the disease on November 20, 2019."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Colorectal Cancer and Alzheimer's Diagnosis
podcast.body: John Mann previously battled colorectal cancer. In 2014, at the age of 50, he was diagnosed with early-onset Alzheimer's. His initial memory issues were attributed to his cancer treatments, but the Alzheimer's diagnosis was made after his cancer went into remission, with the cancer potentially acting as a trigger for the neurological disease. "He'd already endeared colorectal cancer when the Alzheimer's diagnosis was made in 2014."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Community Support and Death
podcast.body: A Vancouver brewery created a special pilsner to help cover John Mann's medical costs, showcasing community support for his battle against Alzheimer's. Despite his efforts and the support he received, John died on November 20, 2019, after doing significant work to raise awareness for others suffering from the cruel disease. "Alzheimer's is a cruel thing, and John died on November 20th, 2019."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Continued Performance and Advocacy
podcast.body: From 2014 onward, John Mann bravely soldiered on, performing for as long as he could, often relying on an iPad to help him recall lyrics. His struggles inspired fundraisers for stem cell treatments, numerous tributes, and special concerts, with his wife, playwright Jillie Dumb, even producing a play called *Forget About Tomorrow* about his experiences. "From 2014 forward, he did his best to soldier on."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Continued Performance and Stem Cell Treatment
podcast.body: John Mann continued performing with Spirit of the West for as long as his deteriorating condition allowed. In 2015, he sought experimental stem cell treatment in Mexico in an attempt to combat the progression of Alzheimer's. "John kept performing as long as he could. There was some stem cell treatment in Mexico in 2015."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Early Memory Issues and Chemo Impact
podcast.body: Upon receiving his Alzheimer's diagnosis, John Mann recognized that he had been experiencing intermittent memory issues as early as 2001, struggling to remember lyrics or guitar chords. The memory problems intensified during his chemotherapy treatments for colorectal cancer between 2009 and 2011, which he initially dismissed as a side effect of the drugs, not realizing it was an early sign of Alzheimer's. "Once he got the diagnosis, he realized that he'd been having on and off memory issues as early as 2001 when he couldn't remember lyrics or what chords he was supposed to play on the guitar."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Early Onset Alzheimer's Diagnosis
podcast.body: John Mann, the singer for Spirit of the West, was diagnosed with early onset Alzheimer's in 2014, when he was in his early 50s. This uncommon form of the disease affects individuals before age 65, accounting for less than 10% of all cases. His diagnosis came while he was in remission from colorectal cancer, which had been diagnosed in 2009. "John was diagnosed with early onset Alzheimer's."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Forget About Tomorrow (Play)
podcast.body: John Mann's wife, Jill, penned a play titled "Forget About Tomorrow," which sensitively explores and documents John's experience and struggles with Alzheimer's disease. "She even wrote a play about John's condition called Forget About Tomorrow."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Musician Friends' Benefit Concerts
podcast.body: John Mann's musician friends, including members of the Barenaked Ladies, Blue Rodeo, and Sarah McLachlan, regularly organized benefit concerts to help fund his medical treatments. These events often featured collective performances of Spirit of the West classics. "And whenever one of these benefits was held, everybody joins in on this Spirit of the West class."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Spirit Unforgettable (Documentary)
podcast.body: A documentary film titled "Spirit Unforgettable" was created to chronicle John Mann's life and his battle with early-onset Alzheimer's, offering an intimate look at his journey. "There's also documentary entitled Spirit Unforgettable."
